_: stranger_things on ScottyWic's 'Stranger Things - SE' 1.47 (the Orbital Scoreboard
build, OSB), a scripted ORIGINAL table: it loads controller.vbs's LoadEM only (B2S,
no ROM), so vpxshadow.py keeps its script as a shadow game and hands the ball to the
real game. ScottyWic's layout is his own, not Stern's, so every switch is matched by
what its hit sub does first and by place on the game's drawing second; GUESS marks
the stretches. The Pro/Premium card (stranger_things) is the fit: the table has no
backpanel telekinesis lock, no Demogorgon mech coil and no ramp diverter coil, which
are what the LE adds. Ids are the rig's switch_list.txt for stranger_things.
Its four flippers: the lower pair are the machine's; the upper pair belong to the
Upside Down (live only while lowerflippersoff is False), driven from the same coils.
No drop targets on the table: the barricade's three targets latch the 4-bank's
first three switches down until the game's reset coil fires (the 4th never closes).
UltraDMD is turned off (the game's LCD is the display); B2SOn stays False so the
table's DOF calls never reach PAD.Controller as B2S calls.

flippers._: the machine's two flipper coils drive the table's lower AND upper (Upside Down) flippers

extra_vbs:
' the table's own flags its game sets at a Start that never comes: the lower
' flippers work only with lowerflippersoff True (the upper pair is the Upside
' Down's, live only while it is False)
lowerflippersoff = True
finalflips = False
' the Upside Down's entry kicker is enabled in the editor and its sequence
' (26 s of video, then a ball swap) is the shadow game's: keep the ball out
BallLockEscape.Enabled = False
Sub PadLFlip(e)
	SolLFlipper e
	SolULFlipper e
End Sub
Sub PadRFlip(e)
	SolRFlipper e
	SolURFlipper e
End Sub
Sub PadLeftEject(e)
	If e Then
		If bsKicker1.Balls > 0 Then bsKicker1.SolOut True
		If bscastlekicker.Balls > 0 Then bscastlekicker.SolOut True
	End If
End Sub
Sub PadDownPost(e)
	If e Then
		If bsBallLockBarb.Balls > 0 Then bsBallLockBarb.SolOut True
		If bsBallLockRun.Balls > 0 Then bsBallLockRun.SolOut True
	End If
End Sub
Sub PadDropTrip(e)
	If e Then
		Controller.Switch(1086) = True
		Controller.Switch(1087) = True
		Controller.Switch(1088) = True
		Controller.Switch(1089) = True
	End If
End Sub
Sub PadDropReset(e)
	If e Then
		Controller.Switch(1086) = False
		Controller.Switch(1087) = False
		Controller.Switch(1088) = False
		Controller.Switch(1089) = False
	End If
End Sub

lamps._: table light -> Spike 2 LEDs [node, index] (several = an RGB insert: lit when any is); ScottyWic's twin lights (ll1/ll8, lb1/lb6 ...) share their insert; GUESS = placed by the script's use of the light and its place, not seen on the game
